Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

- (f) Pensioners can also submit Life Certificates using the Face Authentication technology system based on UIDAI Aadhaar software whereby a Digital Life Certificate is generated from any Android-based smart phone by capturing the live photograph of the pensioner for online submission on the Jeevan Pramaan mobile application.OM, dated 30-9-2022.
- (iv) Non-employment or employment / re-employment certificate in the month of November each year.
